evals.prompt: We need a visual grader to choose which assembly diagram follows a reference. Sets of diagrams have small socket markers and multiple revisions of the same drawing. Build a first candidate and decide what evidence it needs before use.
evals.expected_output: Define the reference and candidate ordering, blind identity, validate effective resolution and order-swapped decisions, split by drawing family, return a schema and criterion for ties or insufficient evidence. Distinguish runnable candidate and validated judge.

evals.prompt: A team wants a judge to list every interval where the on-screen subtitle covers the diagram in a training video. We have labeled intervals for 12 clips and the runner currently sends the first frame only. Can this ship?
evals.expected_output: Hold the temporal claim, define sampling or segment coverage, timestamp and interval matching with one-to-one assignment. Report precision and recall plus uncovered footage and held-out clip-level evidence. Avoid scalar kappa for lists.
